info.title: WDK Indexer API
info.description: API for querying blockchain token transfers and balances across multiple networks. Authenticated endpoints require an API key passed via the X-API-KEY header.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-KEY
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key obtained via the registration form. Include in the X-API-KEY header for all authenticated requests.

get.description: Checks internal dependencies and blockchain indexer sync status. Returns HTTP 200 only when the overall status is `healthy`. Returns HTTP 503 for any non-healthy overall status (`degraded` or `unhealthy`), so readiness probes and load balancers can rely on the HTTP status code alone.

Returns the list of all supported blockchains and their available tokens. Endpoint to discover valid blockchain and token combinations before calling other endpoints. This endpoint reads directly from the server configuration and requires no authentication.

200.description: List of supported blockchains with their tokens and case sensitivity rules

schema.description: List of supported blockchains with their tokens and case sensitivity rules

name.description: Blockchain identifier used as the {blockchain} path parameter in other endpoints.

tokens.description: Token identifiers available on this blockchain, used as the {token} path parameter.

caseSensitive.description: Case sensitivity rules. If present, addresses are preserved as-is (case-sensitive). If absent, addresses are automatically lowercased.

address.description: Indicates address case sensitivity. When the caseSensitive object is present, addresses are not lowercased regardless of this field value.

500.description: Internal Server Error - indexer service unavailable or unexpected failure

schema.description: Internal Server Error - indexer service unavailable or unexpected failure

get.summary: Get token transfers for an address
get.description: Retrieve the token transfer history for a specific wallet address on a given blockchain. Returns incoming and outgoing transfers sorted by block number.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of transfers to return.

parameters.name: fromTs
parameters.description: Start timestamp in milliseconds (inclusive). Use 0 to query from the beginning.

parameters.name: toTs
parameters.description: End timestamp in milliseconds (inclusive). Omit to query up to the latest available data.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Blockchain network identifier. Use GET /api/v1/chains to see all available options.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Token identifier. Must be a valid token for the specified blockchain.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Wallet address to query. Format varies by blockchain (e.g. 0x... for EVM, bc1... for Bitcoin, T... for Tron).

200.description: Token transfer history for the queried address

schema.description: Token transfer history for the queried address

transfers.description: List of token transfers sorted by block number.

transferIndex.description: Index of the transfer within the transaction.

amount.description: Transfer amount as a decimal string.

timestamp.description: Block timestamp in milliseconds since Unix epoch.

transactionIndex.description: Position of the transaction within the block.

logIndex.description: Event log index for EVM chains. null for non-EVM chains like Bitcoin.

label.description: A label associated with the transfer, if any

metadata.description: Chain-specific extra data attached to the transfer, if any.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid parameters, address format, blockchain, or token

schema.description: Bad Request - invalid parameters, address format, blockchain, or token

get.description: Retrieve the transfer records of a single transaction for one token, read from the chain. Only transfers of the requested token are returned, so a transaction moving several tokens has to be queried once per token. Returns 404 when the transaction moved no amount of that token, including when the transaction id does not exist at all.

parameters.name: blockchain
parameters.description: Blockchain network identifier. Use GET /api/v1/chains to see all available options.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Token identifier. Must be a valid token for the specified blockchain.

parameters.name: transactionHash
parameters.description: Transaction id/hash, as returned in the `transactionHash` field of transfers. Format varies by blockchain (e.g. 0x... for EVM, hex for TON, base58 signature for Solana).

schema.description: Transfer records for the queried transaction

transfers.description: All transfers recorded under this transaction for the requested token.

transferIndex.description: Index of the transfer within the transaction.

amount.description: Transfer amount as a decimal string.

timestamp.description: Block timestamp in milliseconds since Unix epoch.

transactionIndex.description: Position of the transaction within the block.

logIndex.description: Event log index for EVM chains. null for non-EVM chains like Bitcoin.

label.description: A label associated with the transfer, if any

metadata.description: Chain-specific extra data attached to the transfer, if any.

post.summary: Register wallets for automatic transaction syncing
post.description: Registers one or more wallets for the authenticated owner. Registered wallet addresses are synced automatically - transfers touching them are collected continuously and can be queried via the wallet transfer endpoints without polling the chain endpoints. Each item is processed independently and returns its own status: 201 created, 400 invalid, 429 wallet limit exceeded. Registration is rejected with 409 if an address is already registered.

schema.description: Array of wallets to register. Maximum 10 items.

type.description: Wallet type. Must be the type this gateway registers.

name.description: Optional display name for the wallet.

addresses.description: Addresses to register, keyed by blockchain (e.g. {"ethereum": "0x...", "bitcoin": "bc1..."}). Use GET /api/v1/chains for supported blockchains.

meta.description: Optional wallet metadata. Required when registering a spark address.

requestBody.description: Array of wallets to register. Maximum 10 items.

200.description: Per-wallet registration results in request order

schema.description: Per-wallet registration results in request order

status.description: Per-item status code: 201 created, 400 invalid, 429 wallet limit exceeded.

enabled.description: Whether the wallet is active for transaction syncing.

meta.description: Optional wallet metadata. Required when registering a spark address.

error.description: Error code when the item was rejected.

limit.description: Wallet limit that was exceeded (present on 429).
